x_snc_airop_check_definition.ai_justification: Active HR services (sn_hr_core_service) define the structured service catalog Now Assist HRSD uses for AI-guided employee lifecycle support including onboarding, offboarding, and lifecycle events. A well-populated HR service catalog is foundational for Now Assist routing and self-service.
x_snc_airop_check_definition.remediation_guidance: Configure HR services for key lifecycle events (onboarding, offboarding, leave, benefits, payroll) via sn_hr_core_service_list.do. Target: 10+ active HR services. Now Assist HRSD uses the service catalog for AI-guided employee lifecycle management.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_snc_airop_check_definition"><x_snc_airop_check_definition action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><ai_justification><![CDATA[Active HR services (sn_hr_core_service) define the structured service catalog Now Assist HRSD uses for AI-guided employee lifecycle support including onboarding, offboarding, and lifecycle events. A well-populated HR service catalog is foundational for Now Assist routing and self-service.]]></ai_justification><check_name>HR Employee Journey Management</check_name><check_script><![CDATA[(function(checkDef, dateFilter) {
    if (!gs.tableExists('sn_hr_core_service')) {
        return { status: 'not_applicable', actualValue: 'sn_hr_core_service not found', finding: 'HR Service Delivery core is not installed. HR service check is not applicable.' };
    }
    var ga = new GlideAggregate('sn_hr_core_service');
    ga.addQuery('active', true);
    ga.addAggregate('COUNT');
    ga.query();
    var count = ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT')) : 0;
    var actualValue = count + ' active HR services';
    if (count >= 10) {
        return { status: 'ready', actualValue: actualValue, finding: count + ' active HR services configured. Now Assist HRSD has a well-structured service catalog for AI-guided employee lifecycle support.' };
    } else if (count >= 3) {
        return { status: 'needs_attention', actualValue: actualValue, finding: 'Only ' + count + ' active HR services (target: 10+). Now Assist HRSD AI-guided lifecycle support will have limited service coverage.' };
    } else {
        return { status: 'not_ready', actualValue: actualValue, finding: 'Fewer than 3 active HR services configured. Now Assist HRSD requires a structured HR service catalog for AI-guided employee lifecycle management.' };
    }
})()]]></check_script><is_active>true</is_active><is_clone_sensitive>false</is_clone_sensitive><is_manual>false</is_manual><module>HRSD</module><number>CHK0002592</number><order>90</order><remediation_guidance>Configure HR services for key lifecycle events (onboarding, offboarding, leave, benefits, payroll) via sn_hr_core_service_list.do.
